label: Vercel Open Source Program
source: https://vercel.com/open-source-program (the current-cohort card grid plus every collapsed past cohort list), each repository then re-read via the GitHub API
note: One row per funded project Vercel names on its open-source program page, tagged with the cohort the page files it under (Spring 2026 28, Winter 2026 34, Fall 2025 28, Summer 2025 24, Spring 2025 21). Every card was then read back through `gh api repos/owner/repo`: 4 card links no longer resolve on GitHub and were dropped rather than shipped, so `projects` is the verified count, not the number of cards on the page. Stars, language, license, description and topics are that API response, not our estimate; Vercel publishes no mentor or maintainer per project, so `m` is empty. This is not a mentored-program archive - it is the list of projects Vercel funds, in the program's own cohort words.
